name: run_sync_scan_pass

key: pang (1990)(ocean)[cr proj inc][t +4 proj inc]/Pang (1990)(Ocean)[cr Proj Inc][t +4 Proj Inc].adf:bootblock:0:01F4
name: check_bit_loop_then_clear

key: pang (1990)(ocean)[cr proj inc][t +4 proj inc]/Pang (1990)(Ocean)[cr Proj Inc][t +4 Proj Inc].adf:bootblock:0:0202
name: clear_bit_and_increment_field
description: Clears bit one of a control byte, calls an unnamed routine, then adds one to a record field. Listed as four instructions, called from two unnamed routines.

name: set_bit_and_decrement_field
description: Sets bit one of a control byte, calls an unnamed routine, then subtracts one from a record field. Listed as four instructions, called from two unnamed routines.

name: spin_countdown_loop

key: pang (1990)(ocean)[cr proj inc][t +4 proj inc]/Pang (1990)(Ocean)[cr Proj Inc][t +4 Proj Inc].adf:bootblock:0:0230
name: configure_disk_dma_for_read
description: Writes several custom chip registers in sequence, including the DMA control register, the interrupt request register, the disk pointer, the ADKCON register and the disk sync register set to the fixed marker word. It then polls a status bit with a large counter and returns zero on success or minus one on timeout. Listed as seventeen instructions, with two calls to unnamed routines.

key: pang (1990)(ocean)[cr proj inc][t +4 proj inc]/Pang (1990)(Ocean)[cr Proj Inc][t +4 Proj Inc].adf:bootblock:0:027A
name: enable_disk_length_register

key: pang (1990)(ocean)[cr proj inc][t +4 proj inc]/Pang (1990)(Ocean)[cr Proj Inc][t +4 Proj Inc].adf:bootblock:0:028A
name: spin_until_status_bit_clears
description: Busy-waits with no outgoing calls while bit five of a byte at a fixed offset is set, then returns. Called from three unnamed routines.

key: pang (1990)(ocean)[cr proj inc][t +4 proj inc]/Pang (1990)(Ocean)[cr Proj Inc][t +4 Proj Inc].adf:bootblock:0:02A2
name: store_and_step_global_counter
description: Saves the current value of a global word into a record field, subtracts 273 from that global, and writes 32 to the interrupt request register. Listed as five instructions, with one call to an unnamed routine.

key: pang (1990)(ocean)[cr proj inc][t +4 proj inc]/Pang (1990)(Ocean)[cr Proj Inc][t +4 Proj Inc].adf:bootblock:0:02B2
name: write_interrupt_request_word
description: Writes the value 32, which has only bit five set, to the interrupt request register. Two instructions long and called from two unnamed routines.

key: pang (1990)(ocean)[cr proj inc][t +4 proj inc]/Pang (1990)(Ocean)[cr Proj Inc][t +4 Proj Inc].adf:bootblock:0:0376
name: wait_status_then_enable_dsklen
description: Busy-waits while bit five of a byte at one fixed offset is set, writes the disk length register with its enable bit set, then waits for bit four of a byte at another fixed offset to be set. Listed as six instructions, called from one unnamed routine.

description: A 12-instruction routine, called from one unnamed routine, that touches the audio control register, the DMA control register, the interrupt enable register and the interrupt request register, and makes one call to another unnamed routine. The register notes say a write to the interrupt enable register with bit 15 set enables interrupts, and a write to the DMA control register with bit 15 set enables DMA channels.

name: wait_flags_then_start_copper
description: A 41-instruction routine that writes a fixed longword pattern into a buffer while a flag is clear, then waits on a global flag and a counter. It loads stored values into chip registers, sets bit 15 of one value before storing it, strobes the copper jump register, and reads the vertical position register. It calls three unnamed routines, and the register notes list the CIA-A fire-button and disk status bits.

name: return_immediately_stub
description: A two-instruction routine that only returns to its caller, reached from eight unnamed routines. It makes no calls and does no other work.

name: install_handler_and_request_value
description: An eight-instruction routine, called from one unnamed routine, that makes one call to another unnamed routine. It stores a routine address into a global, stores the value 2048 into a second global, and touches the interrupt request register.

name: reset_interrupt_state_and_store
description: A 17-instruction routine, called from one unnamed routine, that makes one call to another unnamed routine. It sets a global to 32776 when another global is nonzero, stores a routine address into a global and stores 2048 into a second global. The listed registers include the CIA-A control registers, the interrupt request register and the DMA control register.

name: dispatch_state_via_table
description: A large 139-instruction routine that clears the copper jump strobe register, then branches on several global state values. It makes an indirect call through a table indexed by a state value, and calls two small routines that each merge the constant 246 into register d1. It also calls six other unnamed routines.

name: branch_state_through_table
description: A 92-instruction routine found only as gap bytes and called from one unnamed routine. It makes an indirect call through a table indexed by a state value, decrements a counter, and calls a small routine that merges the constant 246 into register d1, plus seven other unnamed routines.

name: clear_state_and_request_interrupt
description: A 48-instruction routine that touches the background color register and calls five other unnamed routines. Its pseudo-code clears several globals, writes the interrupt request register with a value that sets bits four and five, and conditionally stores fixed words into a table.

name: append_three_entries_when_clear
description: A nine-instruction routine that, when bit two of a flag byte is clear, writes two longwords and a byte into a table entry at a global index and advances that index by eight. It is called from one unnamed routine and makes one listed call to another unnamed routine.

name: track_decimal_digit_changes
description: Extracts the tens and hundreds digits of a global counter by repeated division by ten, and compares each with a stored digit. When a per-digit countdown reaches zero it stores the new digit and resets the countdown. Called from one unnamed routine, with three listed calls to unnamed routines.

name: fill_control_entries_in_loops
description: A 53-instruction routine, called from one unnamed routine, that derives an offset from the upper bits of an input value. It then writes pairs of longword values and a fixed word into a control structure in loops of four iterations.

name: append_long_pair_entry
description: Appends an eight-byte record to a list: two longword values taken from a global and table, and a one-byte value of 255. It then advances the list index by eight. Listed as seven instructions, called from two unnamed routines.

name: append_alternate_pair_entry
description: Appends an eight-byte record to a list in the same way as its neighbouring routine, using a different pair of stored values. It writes a one-byte value of 255 and advances the list index by eight. Listed as seven instructions, called from two unnamed routines.

name: call_state_table_handler
description: An eight-instruction routine that makes an indirect call through a table indexed by a state value, and calls a small routine that merges the constant 246 into register d1. Called from four unnamed routines.

name: advance_timed_sequence_entries
description: A 30-instruction routine that decrements a counter and, when it runs out, loads the next pair of values from a table and advances the table pointer by six. If the threshold check passes it appends an entry to a list, otherwise it decrements a global. Called from one unnamed routine, with one listed call.

name: decrement_countdown_with_reset
description: Decrements a global counter and, if the result is still non-negative, sets a flag byte to 255 and returns. Otherwise it sets the global to 255. Four instructions long, called from one unnamed routine, with one listed call.

name: set_global_to_255
description: A two-instruction routine that stores the value 255 into a global byte and returns. Called from one unnamed routine.

name: set_bitmap_bit_update_words
description: Sets one bit, selected by the low three bits of a byte value, in a bitmap byte, then XORs values into two stored words and adds a difference into a third word. If the results are zero it makes two calls to unnamed routines on one path. Seven instructions, called from one unnamed routine.

name: mark_bitmap_bit_and_compare
description: Sets one bit, selected by the low three bits of a byte value, in a bitmap byte, then XORs a value into a stored word and adds a difference into a second word. It makes three calls to unnamed routines, and on one path makes two calls and returns.

name: forward_two_unnamed_calls
description: A three-instruction routine, called from one unnamed routine, that makes two calls to other unnamed routines and then returns.

name: advance_second_timed_sequence
description: A 30-instruction routine that decrements a timer and, when it runs out, loads the next pair of values from a table and advances the table pointer by six. If a threshold check passes it appends an entry to a list, otherwise it decrements a global. Called from one unnamed routine, with one listed call.

name: decrement_alternate_countdown
description: Decrements a global counter and, if the result is still non-negative, sets a flag byte to 255 and returns. Otherwise it sets the global to 255. Four instructions long, called from one unnamed routine, with one listed call.

name: set_second_global_to_255
description: A two-instruction routine that stores the value 255 into a global byte and returns. Called from one unnamed routine.

name: check_record_list_overlap
description: Walks a list of fixed-size records, skipping inactive ones, and compares each record's position against a bounding box derived from two globals. Called from one unnamed routine, with three listed calls to unnamed routines.

name: scan_record_list_for_hits
description: Walks a list of records and tests whether each active record overlaps a box built from an input position. On a hit with a matching type code it marks that record as consumed and sets a global to 1000 or a flag. Called from two unnamed routines, with one listed call.

name: append_conditional_list_entry
description: Calls an unnamed routine while one counter is nonzero, steps a field every fourth pass, selects a value through a global, and appends an eight-byte entry with a one-byte value of 255. Seven instructions, called from one unnamed routine, with two listed calls.

name: append_adjusted_word_entry
description: Appends an entry to a list whose two words come from a longword with its low word reduced by four, plus a selected value and a one-byte value of 255. Nineteen instructions, called from one unnamed routine.

name: invert_flag_and_clear_pointer
description: Inverts a global value and clears a routine-pointer global to zero, then returns the input register unchanged. Seven instructions, called from two unnamed routines, with one listed call.

name: invert_flag_when_pointer_matches
description: If the routine-pointer global holds the value 25, it inverts a global flag and clears the pointer to zero. Three instructions, called from one unnamed routine, with two listed calls.

name: assign_records_from_table
description: Walks a list of records and, for each active record whose type code is not eight and whose status word is zero, marks it as taken and loads the next table entry. When a count below 24 applies it stores the selected value and a computed position into a parallel array. Called from one unnamed routine.

name: update_active_slot_entries
description: Steps a list of active slots. Each non-empty slot counts down a timer and, while the timer is positive, appends an entry with a position, a value and a one-byte value of 255. A shared field steps by 16 every eighth pass. Its listed calls are to a routine that merges the constant 246 into register d1 and to two unnamed routines.

name: reset_field_and_call_routine
description: Clears a word field, sets a second field to 3, and calls one unnamed routine. Thirteen instructions long, called from one unnamed routine.

name: find_rectangle_containing_point
description: Searches an array of eight-word rectangles for the first one that contains a point given in a second array. It returns minus one when a match is found and zero when none match, and on a match writes 1 or 2 to a byte field depending on a pointer comparison. Thirty-nine instructions long.

name: process_timed_event_table
description: Walks a fixed table of event records, decrementing per-record timers and dispatching on a type code. When an event applies it stores a record into a list and writes fixed values such as 400 and a one-byte flag of 255. The walk ends when the table's leading word is negative.

name: test_value_in_bounds_range
description: Tests whether a position lies inside a rectangle given by four words, honouring a flag byte that enables the test, and returns the adjusted position value. Twenty-three instructions long, called from one unnamed routine.

name: clear_state_fields_then_test
description: Clears several state words and pointer fields of a structure, sets a table entry to a negative marker when a pointer matches, and computes a sum of fields. Thirty-eight instructions long, with three listed calls to unnamed routines.

name: process_structure_state_updates
description: A very large 934-instruction routine called from four unnamed routines. Its pseudo-code tests many flag and counter fields in a structure, adjusts values, and calls eight other unnamed routines. It also calls a one-instruction routine that merges zero into register d0.

name: update_structure_status_fields
description: A 178-instruction routine that tests several flag and counter fields of a structure, sets flag bytes, and stores pointers and values into state words depending on a status code. Called from one unnamed routine, with two listed calls.

name: advance_second_status_structure
description: A 185-instruction routine with a test-and-set sequence on a different structure offset, ending by storing a pointer and a value. Called from one unnamed routine, with one listed call.

name: run_counter_driven_state_step
description: A 290-instruction routine that resets a state structure to zero when its counter reaches zero, stores the current word into a global table with a running index, and clears several flag fields. It calls a routine that merges zero into register d0 and two other unnamed routines.

name: run_timed_record_state_step
description: A 300-instruction state routine that tests a counter field of a structure. When the counter reaches zero it resets several state words, and for a structure other than the global base it stores the current words into a global table entry and advances the index by 18. It calls a routine that merges zero into register d0 and one other unnamed routine.

name: init_state_and_table_record
description: A 34-instruction routine, called from three unnamed routines, that resets state fields and appends an 18-byte table record holding two routine pointers, a status value of 0 or 2, and a one-byte value of 255. A routine that merges zero into register d0 is among its listed calls.

name: init_variant_table_record
description: A 440-instruction routine called from eight unnamed routines. Its decompiled body resets state words and appends a table record like its neighbouring initializer, but with a status value of 1 or 3, and it calls a routine that merges zero into register d0 plus two other unnamed routines.

name: apply_background_color_update
description: A 319-instruction routine, called from five unnamed routines, that touches the background color register and calls four other unnamed routines. The decompiled body shown only stores the value 4095 into a global and returns, so the pseudo-code is partial.

name: pack_position_into_two_words
description: Computes two packed words from an input X value, a Y value and an offset, and stores them at a destination pointer. The first word combines the Y value plus 44 in its high byte with a shifted X-based value; the second combines a sum with bit flags. Fifteen instructions, called from one unnamed routine.

name: dispatch_typed_list_entries
description: Walks a list of nine-word entries and dispatches on each entry's type code. Type one calls one routine, type two calls another, type three stores a longword into a table, and type four clears a longword through a pointer. The walk ends when a flag byte in the entry is negative, after which a global table index resets to zero and a global is set to 255.

name: emit_records_via_register_block
description: Walks a list of 12-byte records, waiting on a status bit before each one, then writes several fixed-offset words of a register block from each record's fields. The walk ends when a record's leading word is negative. Eighteen instructions, executed in the reference run.

name: copy_nearby_records_with_offsets
description: Walks a list of eleven-word records and, for those whose position words lie within a small horizontal window, copies the record into an output area and writes values derived from a vertical offset and a table lookup. The walk ends when a leading word is negative.

name: combine_masked_values_into_buffers
description: A 696-instruction routine, called from three unnamed routines, that touches a custom chip register at offset zero and calls three other unnamed routines. Its pseudo-code combines values with bit masks, writes them into buffers, and decrements a counter stored in a structure field.

name: toggle_buffer_page_pointers
description: Toggles a stored longword between the constants 445232 and 485272 and sets a flag word to match. It then either fills a block of sixteen words with 4095 or adds a fixed offset of 32000 and 8000 steps, and writes split longword addresses into word pairs. Forty-five instructions, executed in the reference run.

name: call_four_routines_in_order
description: A five-instruction routine that makes four calls to other unnamed routines in sequence and then returns. It was executed in the reference run.

name: emit_table_entries_with_strides
description: Selects one of two four-word tables according to a flag word, then for each entry writes five longwords spaced 8000 apart from a computed base, stopping at a negative marker. Fifty-five instructions, called from one unnamed routine.

name: clear_global_word_leaf
description: A two-instruction routine that stores zero into one global word and returns. It was executed in the reference run and is called from one unnamed routine.

name: copy_record_entries_to_globals
description: A 197-instruction routine, called from one unnamed routine, that selects one of two tables by a flag word and walks linked entries. It copies five longword values from each entry into global variables, then writes a marker byte of 255 and two words of 65535. It makes one listed call to another unnamed routine.

name: emit_threshold_table_entries
description: An 85-instruction routine, called from one unnamed routine, that waits on a status bit and then walks one of two tables. Each entry's first word is written to an output pair, entries above 312 trigger a call to an unnamed routine, and entries above 200 end the inner pass. It finishes by writing a marker byte of 255 and two words of 65535.

name: return_at_once_leaf
description: A single-instruction routine that returns immediately. It was executed in the reference run and is called from one unnamed routine.

name: run_per_state_table_passes
description: A 43-instruction routine that returns early unless a counter is at most one. For each of two state checks it walks a linked table of entries, calls unnamed routines, and calls one more routine when a global is nonzero. It has four listed calls.

name: expand_nibbles_into_strided_bytes
description: Reads eight four-bit nibbles from an input value, skipping leading zero nibbles, and for each nonzero nibble writes eight byte values into an output buffer at 40-byte strides. Each byte comes from a lookup table indexed by the nibble. Twenty-three instructions, called from one unnamed routine.

name: copy_block_rows_into_buffer
description: A 35-instruction routine, called from two unnamed routines, that touches the background color register. It selects a source block by index, counting a global down from 10000 when the index is out of range, then copies rows of words from the block into a destination buffer over four passes, advancing the destination by 1120 bytes each pass.

name: dispatch_conditional_calls_by_state
description: A 31-instruction routine that makes conditional calls to unnamed routines, based on a state word and a global counter compared with zero and four. It has four guarded branches and three listed calls.

name: write_two_digit_strided_bytes
description: Clamps an input value to 99, then writes its tens digit and units digit as lookup-table bytes into an output buffer at 40-byte strides. The tens digit is written only when it is nonzero. Thirty instructions, called from one unnamed routine.

name: copy_clamped_rows_nested_loops
description: Clamps an input count to four, then copies sixteen-word rows from a source pointer into a destination buffer in nested loops, writing with fixed strides of 20 and 820 bytes. Seventeen instructions, called from one unnamed routine.

name: append_stage_entry_by_counter
description: Advances a counter byte when it is nonzero. Below four it appends an entry with a shared value and a constant, below nine it appends a similar entry with another constant, and otherwise it clears a flag byte. Twenty-three instructions, with two listed calls.

name: clear_bit_then_spin_countdown
description: Clears one bit, selected by the low three bits of a register value, in a byte at a fixed offset. It then spins in a countdown loop that decrements a 16-bit value until it wraps. Six instructions, called from two unnamed routines.

name: advance_sequence_when_counter_zero
description: A 63-instruction routine that runs only when a state value equals five. When a timer reaches zero it reads a table-driven record, and for a zero code it resets a word to 65280, clears globals, calls three unnamed routines and writes initial values. It has four listed calls.

name: write_four_strided_register_sets
description: A 26-instruction routine, called from one unnamed routine, that waits on a status bit and then writes four sets of fixed words into a register block. The address for each set is 8000 bytes after the previous one, and each set uses the size word 4171.

name: write_four_blocks_with_waits
description: A 113-instruction routine, called from two unnamed routines, that writes four blocks to a register block and waits on a status bit before each one. Block addresses are 8000 bytes apart and use the same size word. It has seven listed calls.

name: write_lookup_bytes_to_buffers
description: Writes eight bytes taken from lookup tables indexed by a global value into two output buffers at 40-byte strides, then advances a pointer global. Twenty-five instructions, called from one unnamed routine, with one listed call.

name: update_table_selection_state
description: A two-instruction routine listed in the table as called from five unnamed routines, with several address-taken references. Its decompiled body sets a bit in a byte, calls a routine that reads from the packed-data decoder, and selects table-driven values into globals. The listed instruction count does not match the decompiled body.

name: refresh_table_selection_flags
description: A nine-instruction routine called from three unnamed routines. It sets a global to 32776, calls a routine that reads from the packed-data decoder, and selects table-driven values into flag globals.

name: rotate_table_selection_bytes
description: A 38-instruction routine executed in the reference run that touches the DMA control register and makes two calls. It sets a packed word of selection bytes from a table indexed by a global value and rotates its bytes before calling an unnamed routine. The listed register is touched, but the shown code does not write its value directly.

name: interpret_packed_command_stream
description: A 70-instruction routine, called from one unnamed routine, that interprets a stream of signed command bytes read through a pointer. A byte of minus 96 ends the stream, and a byte of minus 64 sets a flag and loads values from two lookup tables.

name: parse_command_stream_codes
description: A 58-instruction routine, called from one unnamed routine, that reads signed command bytes from a stream. A byte of minus 96 ends the loop, a byte of minus 80 advances to the following byte, and any other command byte returns early.

name: clear_sprite_registers_after_call
description: A 21-instruction boot block entry, entered from the Kickstart strap, that calls an Amiga library routine at offset minus 456 and clears sixteen longwords from the sprite-zero position register. It writes three values into a record and calls the same library routine again. The DMA control register is also listed as touched.

name: copy_longwords_to_fixed_address
description: An eight-instruction routine, reached by a pc-relative address reference and called from one unnamed routine. It copies longwords from a source address into a fixed destination in a counted loop, then sets a global to 32767 and returns the value 65535. It touches the DMA control register.

key: Pang (1990)(Ocean)[cr HZ][a].adf boot-block load +$B1800 to $040000 (132096 bytes):0:0024
name: decode_packed_bit_stream
description: A 69-instruction depacker routine that touches the background color register. It repeatedly reads bits from a packed stream, calling the bit-reader refill routine when its buffer runs out and the bit-read routine to collect bit counts. It branches on the decoded values to choose its next step.

name: copy_table_longwords_low_memory
description: A 54-instruction routine executed in the reference run that loops until a global flag is set, then copies a run of longwords from a table into low fixed addresses and writes a global value. It touches the audio control, copper jump, DMA control and interrupt enable registers, and calls four unnamed routines plus a routine that merges zero into register d0.

name: run_guarded_state_actions
description: A 78-instruction routine that checks state bytes and port-related flags before performing guarded actions, calling one unnamed routine and two empty stub routines along the way. It touches the CIA-A port register, the interrupt enable register, the vertical position register and the DMA control register. The register notes say the port register carries fire-button and disk status bits.

name: set_handler_pointer_and_value
description: An 11-instruction routine, called from one unnamed routine, that makes two calls, one of them conditional on a flag byte. It stores a routine address into a global, stores the value 2048 into another global, and touches the interrupt request register.

name: store_handler_with_conditional_flag
description: A 14-instruction routine, called from one unnamed routine, that makes three calls and conditionally sets a global to 32776 when another global is nonzero. It then stores a routine address into a global and the value 2048 into a second global.

name: run_state_machine_port_reads
description: A 262-instruction routine, called from four unnamed routines, that clears the copper jump register and branches on several global state values. It makes an indirect call through a table and reads both joystick data registers, which the register notes describe as mouse-port and joystick-port movement. It calls 15 other unnamed routines and one routine that merges zero into register d0.

name: clear_state_and_set_background
description: A 69-instruction routine, called from two unnamed routines, that touches the background color register and calls 19 other unnamed routines. Its pseudo-code clears several globals and flags, makes an indirect call through a table, and runs a countdown loop when a flag is set.

name: append_record_when_flag_clear
description: A nine-instruction routine that, when bit two of a flag byte is clear, writes two longwords and a byte into a table entry at a global index and advances that index by eight. Called from one unnamed routine, with a listed call to an empty stub.

name: update_decimal_digit_countdowns
description: A 49-instruction routine, called from one unnamed routine, that extracts two decimal digits from a global counter by repeated division by ten. It compares each digit with a stored digit, and when a countdown reaches zero it stores the new digit and resets the countdown. It has one listed call to an unnamed routine and one to an empty stub.

name: write_paired_blocks_at_stride
description: A 53-instruction routine, called from one unnamed routine, that derives an offset from the upper bits of an input value. It then loops four times, writing two blocks per pass to a register block with size word 833 and addresses 8000 bytes apart.

name: append_first_pair_entry
description: Appends an eight-byte record to a list: two longword values taken from globals and a one-byte value of 255. It then advances the list index by eight. Seven instructions, called from one unnamed routine.

name: append_second_pair_entry
description: Appends an eight-byte record to a list using a different pair of global longwords, with a one-byte value of 255, then advances the list index by eight. Seven instructions, called from one unnamed routine.

name: dispatch_state_handler_call
description: An eight-instruction routine, called from four unnamed routines, that makes an indirect call through a table indexed by a state value minus one, then returns. Its listed call is to one unnamed routine.

name: scan_bounds_for_record_hits
description: A 17-instruction routine, called from two unnamed routines, that returns early under certain state flags. Otherwise it selects a record list by a state value and tests records against a bounding box derived from two globals. It has two listed calls to unnamed routines and one to an empty stub.

name: match_records_inside_box
description: A 103-instruction routine, called from two unnamed routines, that walks a list of records and tests each active record against a box built from an input position, marking the records that match. Its only listed call is to an empty stub routine.

name: dispatch_record_list_walk
description: A nine-instruction routine, called from one unnamed routine, that selects a starting record by a state value and, when a flag byte is zero, begins walking a record list. It makes two listed calls to unnamed routines.

name: walk_records_and_update_fields
description: A 48-instruction routine, called from two unnamed routines, that walks a list of records while each record's status word is nonnegative, reading six neighbouring fields of each record. Its one listed call is to an empty stub routine.

name: store_value_when_state_allows
description: An eight-instruction routine that stores a value into a byte global unless a state word is two while a flag byte is set. Called from one unnamed routine, with a listed call to an empty stub routine.

name: dispatch_matched_table_entry
description: A ten-instruction routine reached only as gap bytes. When a word equals a stored value it adds 10 to a counter and makes an indirect call through a table indexed by a second word. Its listed call is to an empty stub routine.

name: append_ten_byte_record
description: An 81-instruction routine, called from one unnamed routine, that returns early unless a flag byte is set. Otherwise it appends a ten-byte record holding a fixed longword, a word of 100 and a one-byte value of 255 to a list. It has three listed calls to unnamed routines and one to an empty stub.

name: append_state_record_when_flagged
description: A 98-instruction routine, called from one unnamed routine, that returns early unless a flag byte is set. It sets a state global to 5, appends a ten-byte record with values from a stored longword, a word of 100 and a marker of 255, and makes three listed calls to unnamed routines and one to an empty stub.

name: initialize_record_fields_from_input
description: A 16-instruction routine reached only as gap bytes and called from one unnamed routine. It copies a longword from an input record into a global, sets two pointer fields to a global base, stores the value 3 and a longword with its top byte set, and makes one listed call.

name: initialize_record_pointer_fields
description: A five-instruction routine reached only as gap bytes and called from one unnamed routine. It sets two pointer fields to a global base, stores the value 3 in a word field, and stores a longword with its top byte set.

name: step_record_pointer_with_flags
description: A five-instruction routine, called from one unnamed routine, that makes calls and returns early when a byte is zero. When flags are clear and a counter exceeds one, it advances a list pointer by two and clears the counter when the next word is negative. It has one listed call.

name: advance_record_list_with_flags
description: A 200-instruction routine, called from one unnamed routine, that returns early unless a flag byte is set. Otherwise it advances a record list pointer while testing flags and counters on each step. It has three listed calls to unnamed routines and one to an empty stub.

name: match_records_in_second_list
description: A 93-instruction routine, called from one unnamed routine, that walks a record list and tests each record against a box built from a stored pair of words, appending an entry to an output list when one matches. Its only listed call is to an empty stub routine.

name: append_stepped_value_entry
description: A seven-instruction routine, called from one unnamed routine. When one flag word is nonzero it calls an empty stub. When another is nonzero it steps a counter every fourth pass, selects a value through a pointer, and appends an eight-byte entry with a one-byte value of 255. It has one listed call to an unnamed routine.

name: append_adjusted_longword_entry
description: A 19-instruction routine, called from one unnamed routine, that steps a counter every fourth pass, selects a value through a pointer, and appends an eight-byte entry whose words come from a longword with its low word reduced by four. The entry ends with a one-byte value of 255.

name: clear_two_globals_and_flag
description: Listed as one instruction and called from 13 unnamed routines. The decompiled body clears two global words and a flag byte, then returns a byte value unchanged.

name: clear_two_globals_alternate_entry
description: A single listed instruction reached through an address reference and called from 13 unnamed routines. Its decompiled body matches its neighbouring entry: it clears two global words and a flag byte.

name: clear_two_globals_short_entry
description: A single listed instruction, called from two unnamed routines. Its decompiled body clears two global words and a flag byte, the same action as its neighbouring entries.

name: clear_two_globals_with_call
description: A 20-instruction routine, called from three unnamed routines, that clears two global words and a flag byte. It has one listed call to an unnamed routine.

name: set_globals_from_mode_code
description: A 24-instruction routine, called from two unnamed routines, that does nothing unless a flag byte is set. When a routine-pointer global holds a code from 80 to 83, it sets two global words to the matching value from zero to three and clears the pointer. It makes three listed calls to unnamed routines and one to an empty stub.

name: tail_call_single_routine
description: A two-instruction routine, called from one unnamed routine, that makes one call to another unnamed routine and then returns.

name: set_mode_one_clear_pointer
description: A five-instruction routine reached only as gap bytes. It sets a global to 100, sets a mode byte to 1, makes one listed call to an unnamed routine, and clears a routine-pointer global to zero.

name: set_mode_two_copy_value
description: A 28-instruction routine, called from one unnamed routine, that sets a global to 100 and a mode byte to 2 and makes a call. It copies a longword from a returned pointer into a record field, clears a routine-pointer global, and makes one more call. A separate branch handles mode three by copying from a different pointer.

name: set_mode_three_clear_pointer
description: A 34-instruction routine reached only as gap bytes and called from one unnamed routine. Its decompiled body shown sets a global to 100, sets a mode byte to 3, clears a routine-pointer global and makes a call. It has three listed calls, so the shown body is partial.

name: claim_idle_records_for_slots
description: A 47-instruction routine, called from one unnamed routine and executed in the reference run. When a counter is negative and a mask bit is clear, it walks a record list and marks each idle record, one with a non-eight type code and zero status, as taken, loading the next table entry into it.

name: tick_record_timers_in_list
description: A 141-instruction routine, called from one unnamed routine and executed in the reference run. It walks a list of records, decrementing a timer field on each one and writing a table entry with a computed offset when a timer expires. It stops at a negative leading word and has listed calls to an empty stub and one unnamed routine.

name: clear_word_and_set_three
description: A 13-instruction routine, called from one unnamed routine. It stores zero into a word through its input pointer, sets a record field to 3 and makes one listed call to an unnamed routine.

name: set_limit_and_clear_word
description: A four-instruction routine, called from two unnamed routines, that sets a record field to 250 and stores zero into a word through an input pointer.

name: find_record_overlapping_box
description: A 39-instruction routine, called from two unnamed routines and executed in the reference run. It searches an array of eight-word records for the first one whose box overlaps a box given by an input pointer. It returns zero when none match, and on a match it stores a result through a pointer.

name: gate_record_update_on_counter
description: An eight-instruction routine, called from one unnamed routine and executed in the reference run. It returns early while a counter word is nonzero, decrementing it, and otherwise continues to a record update. It makes two listed calls to unnamed routines.

name: update_record_counters_and_entries
description: A 154-instruction routine, called from two unnamed routines. It decrements a counter field and returns early while the counter is nonzero. Otherwise it updates record fields and appends table entries, with three listed calls to unnamed routines.

name: gate_record_list_scan
description: An eight-instruction routine, called from one unnamed routine and executed in the reference run. It calls a routine when one word is zero, returns early when a status word is nonzero, and otherwise begins walking a record list. It has two listed calls to unnamed routines.

name: walk_records_and_append_entries
description: A 179-instruction routine, called from two unnamed routines, that walks a record list, skipping inactive records and testing status and timer fields. It appends table entries for records that pass, with three listed calls to unnamed routines.

name: pass_through_single_call
description: A three-instruction routine, called from one unnamed routine, that makes one call to another unnamed routine and then returns.

name: step_timed_pair_sequence
description: A 29-instruction routine, called from one unnamed routine and executed in the reference run. When a counter in a record is nonzero it steps through a list of value pairs, decrementing a timer and advancing the list pointer by four when the timer runs out. It has one listed call to an unnamed routine and one to an empty stub.

name: store_handler_and_count_down
description: A 232-instruction routine, called from two unnamed routines, that touches the background color register. The decompiled body shown stores a routine address into a global and counts a global word down from 10000 in a loop. It has three listed calls to unnamed routines and one to an empty stub.

name: update_flagged_record_timer
description: A 166-instruction routine, called from one unnamed routine and executed in the reference run. It returns early unless a flag byte is set. Otherwise it steps a timer, and when a status word is negative it clears the flag and returns zero. It has five listed calls to unnamed routines and one to an empty stub.

name: flag_record_inside_window
description: An 85-instruction routine, called from two unnamed routines. It compares a record's position word with a window derived from a global, and when the record lies inside the window it sets a flag byte and clears a word. Its listed call is to an empty stub routine.

name: append_entry_for_first_pass
description: A 27-instruction routine, called from one unnamed routine and executed in the reference run. It returns early when a state word is negative, sets a global to 7 and a flag on the first pass, then appends a table entry to a list.

name: process_indexed_event_table_pass
description: A 138-instruction routine, called from one unnamed routine and executed in the reference run. It walks a fixed table of event records from a fixed start address until the leading word is negative, decrementing per-record counters. For records whose counter field is negative it looks up a table index and writes a fixed-layout entry.

name: test_point_inside_rectangle
description: A 23-instruction routine, called from one unnamed routine and executed in the reference run. It tests whether a point lies inside a rectangle given by four words at an input pointer, honouring a flag byte that enables the test, and returns the adjusted position value.

name: process_record_list_for_output
description: A 511-instruction routine, called from one unnamed routine and executed in the reference run. Its pseudo-code is long and loops over record lists, computing fields from input values and writing results into globals and output buffers. It makes two listed calls to unnamed routines.

name: update_port_and_record_state
description: A 457-instruction routine, called from six unnamed routines and referenced by a pc-relative address. It touches the CIA-A port register, which the register note says carries fire-button and disk status bits, and makes ten listed calls to unnamed routines. Its pseudo-code is too long to summarise beyond these facts.

name: advance_record_state_machine
description: A 181-instruction routine, called from one unnamed routine and executed in the reference run. It tests flag and counter fields of a structure, sets flags, stores pointers and values into state words depending on a status code, and calls four other unnamed routines.

name: run_record_state_transitions
description: A 188-instruction routine, called from one unnamed routine and executed in the reference run. It runs a structure-state test sequence like its neighbouring routines and has five listed calls to unnamed routines.

name: process_record_state_with_table
description: A 293-instruction routine, called from one unnamed routine and executed in the reference run. It runs a structure-state test sequence that reads tables and writes state words, with five listed calls to unnamed routines.

name: sequence_record_state_steps
description: A 173-instruction routine, called from one unnamed routine and executed in the reference run. It runs another structure-state test sequence and has three listed calls to unnamed routines.

name: evaluate_record_state_pair
description: A 130-instruction routine, called from five unnamed routines and referenced by an absolute move. It takes two word parameters, runs a structure-state test sequence like its neighbours, and has five listed calls to unnamed routines.

name: reset_record_fields_and_register
description: A 34-instruction routine, called from three unnamed routines, that clears several fields of a record and sets a status byte to 255. For a record other than the global base it appends a table entry holding two inputs, two routine pointers and fixed words. It makes one listed call to an unnamed routine.

name: reset_record_fields_variant
description: A 34-instruction routine, called from five unnamed routines, with the same structure as its neighbouring initializer. It clears a different set of record fields and appends a table entry with a different status word. It makes one listed call to an unnamed routine.

name: clear_record_fields_block
description: A 408-instruction routine, called from eight unnamed routines, that clears a long run of fields in a record at fixed offsets, some as longwords and others as words, and then continues with table setup. It makes nine listed calls to unnamed routines.

name: apply_background_color_reset
description: A 320-instruction routine, called from eleven unnamed routines, that touches the background color register and makes eight listed calls. The decompiled body shown only stores 4095 into a global and returns, so the pseudo-code is partial.
